title: Contact Us - Gillette Stadium
content: ## Contact Us. Here at Gillette Stadium, we strive to deliver exceptional customer service. If you have not found the answer to your question via our Stadium A-Z Guide or our interactive “Have a Question” feature, please contact a staff member at one of the phone numbers or email addresses below. * **Ticket Office:** The Ticket Office is located in the Patriot Place Plaza, outside of the Ticketmaster gate at the north end of the stadium. The Gillette Stadium Ticket Office is open on event days only and will open with parking lots. * **Administrative Offices:** (508) 543-8200. Our Customer Service team can be reached at  with any questions, comments, or suggestions that you may have. One Patriot Place Foxborough, MA 02035 (508) 543-8200.
